   - Changed the method `getLoopbackInterface` to return the name of the loopback interface instead of its display name.

In `TestDNS.java`, the actual code changes implement this fix by adding a condition to skip certain tests on Windows, which addresses the problem of spurious test failures due to hostname resolution issues on that operating system. The changes in the test methods and the documentation provide context and rationale for the modifications, ensuring that the tests behave correctly across different platforms.
